summary.text: Leader of the Dardanians in Apollodorus' catalogue of allies who joined the Trojans after nine years of siege — named beside Aeneas and the sons of Antenor, though Homer fixes the Dardanian muster on Aeneas alone.

story.text: Homer's Catalogue sets Aeneas son of Anchises at the head of the Dardanians whom fair Aphrodite conceived amid the spurs of Ida, but does not name Theanus in the muster-roll.
Apollodorus, listing the allies who came to Troy in the tenth year, names Aeneas with Archelochus and Acamas sons of Antenor, and Theanus, as leaders of the Dardanians.
